const same: [(x: number) => void] | [(x: number) => void, string?] = [x => console.log(x.toFixed())];
same[0](3);
const explicit: [(x: number) => void] | [(x: string) => void] = [(x: number) => console.log(x + 1)];
explicit[0](3);
const tail: [...number[], (x: number) => void] = [1, 2, x => console.log(x.toFixed())];
const last = tail[2];
if (typeof last === "function") last(4);
